summary: This plan addresses the security vulnerabilities identified by the Security Agent. The changes include fixing the NoSQL injection vulnerability in the login route by sanitizing the filter object, increasing the bcrypt cost factor from 1 to 12 in the signup route to strengthen password hashing, and removing the plaintext password logging in the login route.

files.rationale: Fix NoSQL injection vulnerability by sanitizing the filter object and remove plaintext password logging
Fix weak password hashing by increasing bcrypt cost factor from 1 to 12
